<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="anISPt8vio0JXgOJ7fEW"> <mxGraphModel dx="1913" dy="5277" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Global Styling & Classes
 classDef inputNode fill:#EBF3FC,stroke:#1B365D,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#0F172A,font-weight:bold;
 classDef processNode fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#334155,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#1E293B;
 classDef engineNode fill:#EDE9FE,stroke:#6D28D9,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#4C1D95,font-weight:bold;
 classDef storageNode fill:#F1F5F9,stroke:#475569,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#0F172A;
 classDef decisionNode fill:#FEF3C7,stroke:#D97706,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#78350F;
 classDef normNode fill:#ECFDF5,stroke:#059669,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#064E3B,font-weight:bold;
 classDef evalNode fill:#FFF1F2,stroke:#E11D48,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#881337,font-weight:bold;
 classDef outNode fill:#F8FAFC,stroke:#0F172A,stroke-width:2px,color:#0F172A,font-weight:bold;

 %% Subsystem 1: ADBG Benchmark Generation Subsystem
 subgraph Subsystem1 [\"<b>SUBSYSTEM 1: ACADEMIC DOCUMENT BENCHMARK GENERATOR (ADBG v1.0)</b>\"]
 direction TB
 S1_Seed[\"Deterministic Seed &<br/>Schema Configuration\"]:::inputNode --> S1_Typst[\"Typst Vector Template<br/>Compilation Engine\"]:::engineNode
 
 S1_Typst --> S1_PDF[\"Vector PDFs (300 DPI)<br/><i>Certificates | Marksheets | ID Cards</i>\"]:::processNode
 S1_Typst --> S1_GT[\"Pixel-Exact Ground-Truth<br/>JSON Annotations\"]:::processNode
 
 S1_PDF --> S1_Raster[\"High-Resolution<br/>Rasterization Engine\"]:::processNode
 
 S1_Raster --> S1_Degradation{\"14-Operator Optical<br/>Degradation Matrix\"}:::decisionNode
 
 S1_Degradation -->|Profile 1| S1_Clean[\"Clean Digital\"]:::processNode
 S1_Degradation -->|Profile 2| S1_Scan[\"Scanner Copy\"]:::processNode
 S1_Degradation -->|Profile 3| S1_Mobile[\"Mobile Camera\"]:::processNode
 S1_Degradation -->|Profile 4| S1_Rot[\"90° Rotation\"]:::processNode

 S1_Clean & S1_Scan & S1_Mobile & S1_Rot --> S1_Repo[(\"<b>AU DIC Benchmark Suite</b><br/><i>(45 Multi-Modal Specimens / 900 Fields)</i>\")]:::storageNode
 S1_GT --> S1_Repo
 end

 %% Decoupled Boundary Link
 S1_Repo ==>|Strict Read-Only Stream| Subsystem2

 %% Subsystem 2: AU DIC Read-Only Evaluation Subsystem
 subgraph Subsystem2 [\"<b>SUBSYSTEM 2: AU DIC EVALUATION & DIAGNOSTIC SUBSYSTEM</b>\"]
 direction TB
 S2_Controller[\"Decoupled Benchmark Controller<br/><i>(isReadOnly: true | Zero DB Mutation)</i>\"]:::inputNode --> S2_Inference[\"Model Prediction Adapter<br/><i>MiniCPM-V 7.6B (Q4_0 via Ollama Runtime)</i>\"]:::engineNode
 
 S2_Inference --> S2_Raw[\"Raw Model Prediction JSON\"]:::processNode
 
 S2_Raw --> S2_Branch{\"Evaluation Protocol<br/>Branch Switch\"}:::decisionNode
 
 %% Pass A Branch
 S2_Branch -->|Pass A: Raw Mode| S2_Comparator[\"Candidate Comparator<br/>& Field Matcher\"]:::processNode
 
 %% Pass B Branch
 S2_Branch -->|Pass B: Normalized Mode| S2_Normalizer[\"<b>Six-Stage Semantic CanonicalNormalizer (N)</b><br/>• Date (N_date) &nbsp;• Roll No (N_id)<br/>• Grade (N_num) &nbsp;• Degree (N_deg)<br/>• Whitespace (N_ws) &nbsp;• University (N_univ)\"]:::normNode
 S2_Normalizer --> S2_Comparator
 
 S2_Comparator --> S2_Taxonomy[\"<b>Nine-Class OCR Error Taxonomist</b><br/><i>EXACT_MATCH | FORMAT_ERROR | OCR_ERROR<br/>NORMALIZATION_ERROR | FIELD_MISSING | HALLUCINATION</i>\"]:::evalNode
 
 S2_Taxonomy --> S2_Stats[\"<b>Statistical Hypothesis & Inference Engine</b><br/>• McNemar Continuity χ² &nbsp;• Wilcoxon Signed-Rank<br/>• Paired Student's t-Test &nbsp;• 10,000 Bootstrap 95% CIs\"]:::engineNode
 end

 %% Final Publication Artifacts
 Subsystem2 ==> S3_Artifacts[\"<b>Immutable Publication Artifacts</b><br/>• metrics.json &nbsp;• predictions.json &nbsp;• comparisons.json<br/>• 300-DPI Publication Figures & LaTeX/Word Tables\"]:::outNode
